K01.name: Lumière Oval Solitaire Pendant
K01.note: it hangs on a black velvet display card held by a thumb, with a price and a code written over the photo: ignore the card, the thumb and all the writing, and take only the pendant and its chain.
K01.detname: IMAGE 2 is a close view of the same pendant: the authority on the stone, the claws, the jump ring and the bail.
K01.lock: AN OVAL SOLITAIRE PENDANT on a gold ROPE chain: ONE clear OVAL brilliant-cut faceted stone, about 11mm wide and 9mm tall, set EAST-WEST, its long axis HORIZONTAL so it is wider than it is tall, held by FOUR short polished gold claws at its four diagonal corners (top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right) joined by a thin gold rim round its girdle; at the top of the rim a small round gold jump ring links it to a smooth polished gold BAIL, about 6mm tall and 3mm wide, rounded and tapered like a teardrop, a little wider at the top; the bail threads onto a twisted gold ROPE chain about 2mm thick.
K01.neg: One stone only, clear, an oval laid sideways, never stood upright, never round, never a cushion, never an emerald cut; four claws only, no halo, no pave, no stones on the bail; the bail is plain polished gold; the chain is a twisted rope chain, never a cable, box, snake or curb chain.
K01.scale: The stone is about 11mm wide and 9mm tall, about the size of a fingernail; the whole pendant from the top of the bail to the bottom of the stone is about 17mm; the rope chain is about 2mm thick, a fifth of the stone's width.
K01.wscale: Worn, the pendant is small: the stone is about 11mm wide, about a quarter of the width of her lips, hanging just below the hollow of the throat on the rope chain.
K01.place: laid on the top face, the rope chain in a soft V and the oval pendant at its point
K01.macro: the oval stone laid sideways in its four gold claws, the small jump ring and the polished tapered bail above it, with a little of the twisted rope chain
K01.palm: the pendant lying in the centre of the open palm, its rope chain trailing over the fingers
K01.pscale: The stone is about the size of a fingernail, much smaller than the palm.

K02.name: Marquise Solitaire Studs
K02.note: the two studs sit on a black velvet display card held by fingers, with a price and a code written over the photo: ignore the card, the fingers and all the writing, and take only the pair of earrings.
K02.detname: IMAGE 2 is a close view of one of the same studs: the authority on the stone and its claws.
K02.lock: A PAIR OF MARQUISE SOLITAIRE STUDS: each stud is ONE clear MARQUISE-cut (navette, a long pointed oval) faceted stone, about 13mm long and 7mm wide, standing UPRIGHT with one point straight up and one straight down, held by FOUR short polished gold claws, two on each long side near the two ends, so both pointed tips are bare; a thin gold rim follows its edge; a post at the back. The two studs are identical.
K02.neg: Each stone is a long pointed marquise, never a pear, an oval or a round; one stone per stud, clear only; no halo, no pave, no drop, no jacket; the tips are bare, never capped with V prongs; no third earring.
K02.scale: Each marquise is about 13mm long and 7mm wide, about as long as a fingernail and half as wide.
K02.wscale: Worn, each stud sits upright on the centre of the earlobe, about 13mm long, under a quarter of the ear's height, never longer than the lobe.
K02.place: the two studs lying face up side by side on the top face, both upright, about a centimetre apart
K02.macro: one stud: the long pointed marquise stone in its four gold claws, both bare tips and the thin gold rim
K02.palm: the pair of studs lying face up side by side in the centre of the open palm
K02.pscale: Each stud is about as long as a fingernail.

K03.name: Petite Pear Solitaire Studs
K03.note: the two studs sit on a black velvet display card held by fingers, with a price and a code written over the photo: ignore the card, the fingers and all the writing, and take only the pair of earrings.
K03.detname: IMAGE 2 is a close view of one of the same studs: the authority on the stone and its claws.
K03.lock: A PAIR OF PEAR SOLITAIRE STUDS: each stud is ONE clear PEAR-cut faceted stone, about 8mm long and 6mm wide, with its narrow POINT at the TOP and its round end at the BOTTOM, held by THREE short polished gold claws: one over the point and one at each side of the round end; a thin gold rim follows its edge; a post at the back. The two studs are identical.
K03.neg: Each stone is a pear with the point up, never a heart, never round, never a marquise, never upside down; one stone per stud, clear only; three claws only, no halo, no pave, no drop; no third earring.
K03.scale: Each pear is about 8mm long and 6mm wide, smaller than a fingernail.
K03.wscale: Worn, each small stud sits on the centre of the earlobe, point up, about 8mm long, much smaller than the lobe.
K03.place: the two studs lying face up side by side on the top face, both point up, about a centimetre apart
K03.macro: one stud: the pear stone point up in its three gold claws and the thin gold rim
K03.palm: the pair of studs lying face up side by side in the centre of the open palm, both point up
K03.pscale: Each stud is smaller than a fingernail.

K04.name: Pear Baguette Duet Studs
K04.note: the two studs sit on a black velvet display card held by fingers, with a price and a code written over the photo and a dark patch painted over part of the card: ignore the card, the fingers, the patch and all the writing, and take only the pair of earrings.
K04.detname: IMAGE 2 is a close view of the LEFT earring of the same pair: the authority on its two stones and their claws.
K04.lock: A PAIR OF PEAR AND BAGUETTE DUET STUDS: each stud is TWO clear stones side by side and touching, each in its own short polished gold claws: ONE upright rectangular BAGUETTE (a step-cut rectangle), about 9mm tall and 4.5mm wide, with a claw at each of its four corners; and right beside it ONE PEAR-cut faceted stone, about 10mm long and 6.5mm wide, its narrow POINT at the TOP, leaning slightly in towards the baguette, and its round end at the bottom, held by three claws, one over the point and one at each side of the round end. The pear sits HIGHER than the baguette: its point rises about 3mm above the baguette's top and its round end stops about 2mm above the baguette's bottom. Each stud is about 12mm wide and 12mm tall. The pair is MIRRORED: on the left earring the baguette is on the left of its pear, on the right earring the baguette is on the right of its pear, so the two baguettes are on the outside and the two pears face each other in the middle.
K04.neg: Exactly two stones per earring, one baguette and one pear, never three, never a halo, never a cluster of round stones; the baguette is a slim straight-sided upright rectangle, never a square, never a marquise; the pear is point up, never upside down; clear stones only, no colour; no drop; the two earrings are mirror images, never two identical earrings.
K04.scale: Each stud is about 12mm wide and 12mm tall, about the size of a fingernail; the pear is about 10mm long and the baguette about 9mm tall.
K04.wscale: Worn, each stud sits on the centre of the earlobe, about 12mm across, a little smaller than the lobe, about a fifth of the ear's height.
K04.place: the two studs lying face up side by side on the top face, mirror images of each other, the baguettes on the outside and the pears in the middle
K04.macro: one stud, the LEFT earring: the upright baguette on the left and the pear beside it on the right, point up, each in its own gold claws
K04.palm: the pair of studs lying face up side by side in the centre of the open palm, mirror images, the baguettes on the outside
K04.pscale: Each stud is about the size of a fingernail.

K05.name: Heart Solitaire Drop Studs
K05.note: the two earrings sit on a black velvet display card held by fingers, with a price and a code written over the photo and a dark patch painted over part of the card: ignore the card, the fingers, the patch and all the writing, and take only the pair of earrings.
K05.detname: IMAGE 2 is a close view of one of the same earrings: the authority on the heart, the little loop, the jump ring and the stone's claws.
K05.lock: A PAIR OF HEART SOLITAIRE DROP STUDS: each earring is a small smooth PUFFED HEART of plain polished gold, about 7.5mm across and 6.5mm tall, sitting upright on a post as the stud; from the heart's lower point a tiny gold loop and ONE small round gold jump ring carry ONE round brilliant-cut clear stone, about 6mm across, held in FOUR fine gold claws set at its top, bottom, left and right; the stone hangs free just below the heart and can swing. The whole earring is about 17.5mm long. The two earrings are identical.
K05.neg: The heart is plain polished gold, puffed and smooth, never set with stones, never an outline, never flat or engraved; exactly one round clear stone hangs below each heart, never a pear, never two stones; the stone hangs on a jump ring, never fixed straight onto the heart; no chain; no third earring.
K05.scale: Each heart is about 7.5mm across, smaller than a fingernail; the round stone is about 6mm, a little smaller than the heart; the whole earring is about 17.5mm long.
K05.wscale: Worn, the small gold heart sits on the centre of the earlobe and the round stone hangs just below the lobe; the whole earring is about 17.5mm long, under a third of the ear's height.
K05.place: the two earrings lying face up side by side on the top face, each heart at the top and its round stone just below it, about a centimetre apart
K05.macro: one earring: the polished puffed gold heart, the tiny loop and jump ring under its point, and the round stone in its four claws
K05.palm: the pair of earrings lying face up side by side in the centre of the open palm, the hearts at the top
K05.pscale: Each heart is smaller than a fingernail.

K06.name: Petite Pear Solitaire Ring
K06.note: it is worn on the middle finger of a hand held over a teal velvet tray, with a price and the word Adjustable written over the photo: ignore the hand, the tray and all the writing, and take only the ring.
K06.detname: IMAGE 2 is a close view of the same ring on the finger: the authority on the pear stone, its claws and the band.
K06.lock: A PEAR SOLITAIRE RING: ONE clear PEAR-cut faceted stone, about 9mm long and 6mm wide, set lengthways along the finger with its narrow POINT towards the fingertip, held a little above the band in fine polished gold claws, one claw over the point and two around the round end; a SLIM plain polished gold band about 1.5mm wide and smooth all round; the band is OPEN at the back, its two ends finishing in small rounded polished tips, so the ring adjusts.
K06.neg: One pear stone only, clear, never round, never oval, never a marquise, never a heart; no halo, no pave on the band, no side stones; the band is slim and plain, never wide, never twisted, never textured.
K06.scale: The pear stone is about 9mm long and 6mm wide, about half the width of the finger; the band is about 1.5mm wide.
K06.wscale: Worn, the pear stone is small: about 9mm long, about half the width of the finger it sits on, lying along the finger with its point towards the fingertip.
K06.place: standing upright on the top face, the pear stone at the top facing camera with its point up, the slim band below it open at the back
K06.macro: the pear stone point up in its fine gold claws and the slim polished band leaving it on both sides
